title: Lap siding.
officialText:
Fiber-cement lap siding having a maximum width of 12 inches (305 mm) shall comply with the
requirements of ASTM C 1186, Type A, minimum Grade II. Lap siding shall be lapped a minimum of 1¼ inches (32 mm) and
lap siding not having tongue-and-groove end joints shall have the ends sealed with caulking, covered with an H-section joint
cover, located over a strip of flashing or shall be designed to comply with Section 1403.2. Lap siding courses shall be installed
with the fastener heads exposed or concealed in accordance with the approved manufacturers’ instructions.
